'''"Your Stars And Mine"''' was a feature section of the ''[[Chandrilan Daily Messenger]]'', written by the Society News Editor [[Morgraine Delefrenquin]]. It covered the premiere of the [[Holodrama/Legends|holodrama]] ''[[Denizens of Dakaret IX]]'' starring [[Quintana Trill]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
